name: Femoral Anteversion in Children
definition: Increased femoral neck anteversion causing intoeing gait, commonly physiologic and self-correcting during childhood.

investigations.principle: Imaging is usually unnecessary in typical developmental cases.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury, deformity or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Reassurance and observation in most children
amber: Derotational osteotomy is rarely needed for severe persistent functional deformity.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Gait/limb rotational phenotype may be documented descriptively.

patientEducation.summary: Increased femoral neck anteversion causing intoeing gait, commonly physiologic and self-correcting during childhood.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
